messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "family or caregivers should watch for sudden behavioral changes"
set: ["family or caregivers should watch for sudden behavioral changes", "mood or behavioral changes", "family or caregivers should monitor mood or symptoms", "family or caregivers should be alert to changes in mood or symptoms", "watch for changes in alertness", "monitor for sudden vision changes", "family history of sudden death", "tell family members or caregivers which symptoms to watch for so they can call provider if not able to", "new or sudden changes in mood or behavior", "caregivers", "tell doctor about sudden mood or behavior changes", "new or sudden changes in mood, behavior, thoughts, or feelings", "caregivers or patients should be trained on proper injection techniques", "sudden numbness or weakness", "monitor for blood pressure changes when dose changes", "family or close friends should know how to give injection in emergency"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
